info.name: Tenevo Store API
info.description:
The public Store API, version 1.3.

Set `clientCode`, `username`, `publicKey`, `privateKey` and `secret` - ideally in an environment, so that the keys are not saved into the collection. Every request is then authenticated and signed for you. See Connecting in the docs for how the signing works.

item.name: API Rotate
item.description: Lets an API user replace its own keys

request.description: This allows an API user to rotate its own keys - the ones the request is signed with, and nobody else's. It keeps its username, owner and scope, and is given a new public key, private key and secret, which are returned this once. The current keys keep working for 24 hours, or until they expire if sooner, so the integration can switch over. The new keys last as long as the current ones were issued for. An extension's cannot be rotated here, as the system it connects to holds the keys too - reconnect the extension instead. An API user is rotated once; rotate with the new keys after that

item.description: Manages the API users that reach this API - the tenant's own, and those belonging to its extensions

query.description: The fields to return, comma separated - `_basic_` returns every field but no sub-fields. Any field used in `query` or `order` must be listed
Filters the results, such as `status:"open"` - see Usage in the docs
Sorts the results by `field:asc` or `field:desc`, comma separated
Results per page - 20 by default, 50 at most
The page of results to return

request.description:
This allows you to list the API users that reach this API. The keys themselves are only ever returned when an API user is created or rotated

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowed_ips` | String | The IP addresses and CIDR ranges the API user may be used from, comma separated, or * for anywhere |
| `allowed_methods` | String | The HTTP methods the API user may use, comma separated, or * for any |
| `allowed_resources` | String | The resources the API user may use, comma separated, wildcards allowed, or * for any |
| `created_at` | Datetime | A UTC datetime of when the API user was created |
| `description` | String | A description of the API user |
| `expires_at` | Datetime | A UTC datetime of when the API user expires - empty if it never does |
| `name` | String | The name of the API user |
| `owner` | String | The name of what the API user belongs to - an extension's slug for an extension's, and empty for the tenant's own |
| `owner_id` | Integer | The ID of the administrator (for their own) or extension the API user belongs to - empty for the tenant's own |
| `owner_type` | String | What the API user belongs to |
| `public_key` | String | The API user's public key - its private key and secret are only ever returned when it is created or rotated |
| `replaced_by_id` | Integer | The ID of the API user that replaced this one when it was rotated |
| `replaces_id` | Integer | The ID of the API user this one replaced, while that one still exists - empty once it has been revoked |
| `rotated_at` | Datetime | A UTC datetime of when the API user was rotated - empty if it never has been |
| `rotated_from_id` | Integer | The ID of the API user this one replaced, whether or not it still exists |
| `status` | String | The status of the API user - expired once past its expiry, replaced once rotated and its replacement is live, expiring within 14 days of its expiry, and active otherwise |
| `username` | String | The API username |

| `uom_size` | Integer | The size of the corresponding Unit of Measure used |
| `updated_at` | Datetime | A UTC datetime of when the item was last updated |
| `variant_id` | Integer | A valid Variant ID |

request.description:
This allows you to list product variant components

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `barcode` | String | The manufacturers barcode on the item |
| `can_backorder` | Boolean | Indicates whether the variant can be back ordered, or not - a null value indicates the parent product `can_backorder` status will be used |
| `can_purchase` | Boolean | Indicates whether the product can be purchased, or not (uses can_backorder as well as looking at variant stock levels) |
| `can_shipindividually` | Boolean | Indicates whether the component can be shipped individually, or not |
| `component_variant_id` | Integer | A valid Product Variant ID |
| `created_at` | Datetime | A UTC datetime of when the component was created |
| `depth` | Integer | The depth of one unit of the variant, in millimetres, required when product is physical |
| `full_name` | String | The full name of the variant (the product name and the options, seperated by / characters) |
| `image_alt_text` | String | The alt text for the product variant image |
| `image_id` | Integer | A valid Product Image ID |
| `image_url` | String | The relative URL to the product variant image |
| `inventory_allocated` | Integer | The amount of the variant that has been allocated to orders in primary Unit of Measure units |
| `inventory_available` | Integer | The amount of the variant that is available to be purchased (inventory_quantity - inventory_allocated) in primary Unit of Measure units |
| `inventory_quantity` | Integer | The amount of the variant that is held in stock in primary Unit of Measure units |
| `inventory_reserved` | Integer | The amount of the variant that is reserved in a basket/checkout, this is included within inventory_available in primary Unit of Measure units |
| `length` | Integer | The length of one unit of the variant, in millimetres, required when product is physical |
| `name` | String | The name of the variant (uses the options, seperated by / characters) |
| `quantity` | Integer | The number of the variant to include |
| `sku` | String | The SKU of the variant |
| `uom` | String | The name of the Unit of Measure |
| `uom_id` | Integer | A valid UOM ID |
| `uom_inventory_allocated` | Integer | The amount of the variant that has been allocated to orders, in Unit of Measure terms |
